revisions.description: Downloads a file from a SharePoint document library to the workspace through Microsoft Graph. The app registration needs the Sites.Read.All or Files.Read.All application permission, or Sites.Selected with a grant on the site.

params.label: Tenant ID
params.helpertext: The Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra app registration
params.name: tenantId

params.label: Client ID
params.helpertext: The Application (client) ID of the app registration
params.name: clientId

params.label: Client Secret
params.helpertext: A client secret of the app registration. The task gets its own app-only Microsoft Graph token with it
params.name: clientSecret

params.label: Site
params.helpertext: The site's URL (any page under the site will do) or its Graph site ID
params.name: site

params.label: Document Library
params.helpertext: The library's name, e.g. Documents. Blank is the site's default library
params.name: library

params.label: File Path
params.helpertext: The file's path in the library, e.g. Releases/2026/notes.md
params.name: path

params.label: Destination
params.helpertext: A workspace file or directory, absolute or relative to /workspace. A directory (or a path ending in /) keeps the file's name
params.name: destinationPath

results.description: The absolute path of the downloaded file
results.name: path
